title: Outlook: reply with a template in inbox rules
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's rollout notice and distinguishes its December general-availability window from the roadmap's October target. The existing Inbox Rules control and qualified Outlook licensing statements are supported; searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps in feature-specific documentation.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The Inbox Rules control is reached in EAC through Roles > Outlook web app policies > policy > Features > Manage features > Information management > Inbox Rules.
claims.quote: In the EAC, go to Roles > Outlook web app policies. Features: Select Manage features. ... Information management

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Exchange PowerShell Set-OwaMailboxPolicy -Identity <policy name> -RulesEnabled $false disables rule viewing, creation and modification.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the Outlook on the web mailbox policy that you want to modify. ... $false: Users can't view, create, or modify server-side rules in Outlook on the web.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The user-scoped Inbox Rules mailbox policy setting governs custom rule creation and editing in Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows.
claims.quote: Information management: ... Inbox Rules: If set to Enabled, a user can create and edit custom rules in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling Inbox Rules restricts rule creation generally, rather than only the reply-with-template action.
claims.quote: The RulesEnabled parameter specifies whether a user can view, create, or modify server-side rules in Outlook on the web. ... $false: Users can't view, create, or modify server-side rules in Outlook on the web.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope: Mailbox policy default
claims.claim: RulesEnabled defaults to $true, allowing users to view, create and modify server-side rules in Outlook on the web.
claims.quote: $true: Users can view, create, or modify server-side rules in Outlook on the web. This value is the default.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The RulesEnabled parameter reference does not state what happens to already-existing rules.
claims.quote: Searched: Set-OwaMailboxPolicy RulesEnabled Identity false server-side rules default true. Read the fetched RulesEnabled section: it describes viewing, creation and modification, not execution of existing rules.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; Governance controls
claims.claim: No separate admin UI or API switch for the reply-with-template action alone is documented on Learn as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Exchange Online Set-OwaMailboxPolicy New-InboxRule reply template ReplyWithTemplate enabled disable. Read New-InboxRule, Set-OwaMailboxPolicy, policy-management and Disable-InboxRule; no separate action-only UI/API switch found.
